title: Creature Classification Model

classification_axes.label: Biological / ecological identity
classification_axes.meaning: Biological or ecological identity such as Animal or Plant; independent of game type, cognition, personhood and relationship roles.

classification_axes.label: Game creature type
classification_axes.meaning: Source-backed game-facing creature type family or unresolved type usage. Multiple values are permitted only where source authority supports overlap or conflict.

classification_axes.label: Nested subtype / category
classification_axes.meaning: Named subdivision under a source-backed type family; does not automatically become a global base type.

classification_axes.label: Body plan / manifestation
classification_axes.meaning: Physical, movement or manifestation classification such as Fey body type, Plant movement category or Incorporeal manifestation.

classification_axes.label: Origin / affinity
classification_axes.meaning: Source-backed origin, provenance, elemental, energy or comparable affinity without automatic type replacement.

classification_axes.label: Template / modifier / transformation
classification_axes.meaning: Source-backed variant, stage, form, template, type modifier, curse or transformation relationship.

classification_axes.label: Condition / state
classification_axes.population_owner: PPIA-02 / governing runtime or source authority
classification_axes.meaning: Persistent or temporary source/rules condition. Live-instance state remains runtime-owned and is not canonical Definition classification.

classification_axes.label: Intelligence / cognition
classification_axes.meaning: Source-backed cognition, intelligence or agency descriptors, independent of biology and game type.

classification_axes.label: Personhood / sapience
classification_axes.meaning: Source/owner-backed personhood and sapience states. Personhood never follows automatically from type, biology or NPC presentation.

classification_axes.label: Habitat / ecology
classification_axes.meaning: Creature-side requires, prefers, tolerates, excludes and depends-on predicates against ENV-HS-1.0; suitability is not distribution.

classification_axes.label: World / Reality / geographic distribution
classification_axes.meaning: Source-backed canonical native, introduced, domesticated, invasive, migratory or other distribution scope, kept separate from habitat suitability.

classification_axes.label: Ecological role
classification_axes.meaning: GM-useful source-backed ecological and encounter-search roles without redefining creature type.

classification_axes.label: Domestication / training
classification_axes.meaning: Domestication, trainability, autonomy and consent-relevant classification; capability never establishes ownership or an existing bond.

classification_axes.label: Relationship / pathway eligibility
classification_axes.meaning: Mount, pack/work/service, pet/companion, familiar or supernatural-bond pathway eligibility using existing CCP authority; eligibility does not create relationship state.

classification_axes.label: NPC-capable presentation
classification_axes.meaning: Eligibility for Creature, NPC Persona or Sentient Creature/NPC Hybrid presentation; presentation is not identity, biology or personhood.

classification_axes.label: Encounter / runtime role
classification_axes.meaning: Source-backed or placement-scoped encounter role. Campaign placement and live runtime state remain separate identities from the reusable Definition.

preserved_unresolved_queue.subject: Vampire / Fell / Undead
preserved_unresolved_queue.reason: Retained sources separately support Fell examples, vampirism transformation semantics and Undead type semantics without one universal collapse.

preserved_unresolved_queue.subject: Chaos Demons / Chaos / Demonic
preserved_unresolved_queue.reason: Chaos Demons are a Demonic subtype while Chaos is independently source-backed as a base type family.

preserved_unresolved_queue.subject: Hardlight / Digital / Construct / Magitech
preserved_unresolved_queue.reason: Hardlight is used inside Digital while cross-tag interactions with Construct and Magitech remain source-visible.

preserved_unresolved_queue.subject: Divinetech / Divine / Construct
preserved_unresolved_queue.reason: Divinetech is a Divine subtype described with machine/construct language; no source rule authorizes forced Construct replacement or exclusivity.

preserved_unresolved_queue.subject: Beast / Animal / Beastfolk
preserved_unresolved_queue.reason: Beast stat-block usage, biological Animal identity and playable conversion labels remain separate axes.

preserved_unresolved_queue.subject: Illusion orphan type usage
preserved_unresolved_queue.reason: Incorporeal source stat blocks use Illusion as a Type value without a recovered retained Illusion family contract.

preserved_unresolved_queue.subject: Dragon category / type / stage normalization
preserved_unresolved_queue.reason: Dragon category terminology, stat-block type fields and age-stage coverage remain uneven across the source family.

reference_cases.authority_note: Illustrates axis placement only; it does not create a new canonical Creature Definition.

biological_ecological_identity: Animal-origin ecological identity retained as source lineage/context where supported

reference_cases.authority_note: Only the explicit source Type Change authorizes game-type replacement; no universal biological/personhood inference follows.

game_creature_type: Illusion (source stat-block usage; unresolved family contract)

reference_cases.source_basis: CEW program invariants + Player Creatures.PDF conversion labels

personhood_sapience: independent source/owner-supported axis; unknown unless established

boundaries: CEW-03 defines classification structure and non-inference semantics; it does not bulk-populate the corpus.
Reusable Definition identity remains CEW-ID/PPIA-governed and distinct from classification, Campaign placement and live instance.
CEW-04 owns habitat/ecology population, CEW-05 distribution, CEW-06 ecological/encounter roles, CEW-09 cognition/personhood/domestication, CEW-10 Havalaea and CEW-11 relationship-pathway crosswalks.
No Multiversal-app schema, UI, runtime, migration, encounter, mount, pet or familiar implementation mutation is authorized.
